description: This file defines a custom Android widget named LogTextBox that extends TextView. It provides an editable, scrollable text box for displaying logs or messages, with default behavior to scroll and allow text modification.

classes.description: A custom TextView that is editable and scrollable, designed for displaying log messages or text output in Android applications.
